title: Swagcoin
description: Add Swagcoin to your game! Inspired by SMP Online!
body:
Add swagcoin to your minecraft game! This resource pack is based on Season 1 and 2 of CallMeCarson's SMP Online server. More info is available [here.](https://smponline.fandom.com/wiki/Swagcoin) Example [here.](https://youtu.be/aE_Xv9Lbr-Q?si=JUlQk9NOIlfutKz-&t=920)

This resource pack changes the cookie texture to an HD cookie image and changes the name of the cookie in the en_us language to "Swagcoin."

Enjoy!
